title: Four Stages of Meditation (ORIGINAL)
description: All that I ask of you for this session is to find a calming place to listen, where you won't be disturbed. Are you sitting comfortably? Then come join me in a moment of quiet stillness and peace of mind, as we renew our daily intentions and commitment to practicing the four stages of meditation together: 'Overcoming Laziness' is the first stage.'Remember the Instructions' is the second stage.'Applying the Antidote' is the third stage.'Resting in Practiced Ease' is the fourth stage.
author: Mistress Shibby
